quotes: Both Knight and Landed Noble imply a feudal position within society, which Jews cannot occupy.
must take Educated (Hebrew) instead to gain access to Academic Abilities

entries.title: Outsider Flaw for Jewish Characters
entries.summary: Non-magus Jewish characters typically take a form of the Outsider Flaw (Major for companions, new Minor for grogs), which is incompatible with the Hermetic Magus Social Status Virtue.
quotes: Non-magi Jewish characters typically take a form of the Outsider Flaw

entries.title: Jewish Companions Must Take Outsider
entries.summary: Jewish companions must take the Major Outsider Flaw to represent the prejudice they face outside Jewish communities and the covenant.
quotes: Jewish companions must take the Outsider Major Flaw

entries.title: The Dhimmi Flaw in Egypt
entries.summary: Explains the legal status of non-Muslims in Egypt and lists what a dhimmi character must not do, which is the extended rule behind the Minor General Flaw Dhimmi; European characters may use Outsider instead.
quotes: Their duties and proscriptions are reflected in the Dhimmi Flaw, which is a Minor General Flaw. Characters from Europe might use Outsider instead.

entries.title: Debterah (Ethiopian holy societas)
entries.requires: Holy Societas: Debterah (Ethiopian church lay cantors and amulet-makers)
entries.summary: Sidebar on Saint Yared and the debterah, an Ethiopian Christian holy societas, giving its favored Abilities and a stand-in Virtue and Ability package for using debterah without Realms of Power: the Divine. Also notes the Yared chant books as a summa on Organization Lore: Ethiopian Church.
quotes: Adjuration, Blessing, Craft Amulets, Invocation.
These books collectively act as a summa of Organization Lore: Ethiopian Church, Level 5, Quality 8.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Divine Revised p.34, 37, 48-50, 137

entries.title: Tainted Virtues and Flaws
entries.summary: Tainted Virtues and Flaws are Infernal; sets limits on how many a character can take at creation and notes that granted supernatural abilities are Infernal powers.
quotes: no more than half a character's Virtues should be tainted
Supernatural abilities granted by Tainted Virtues or Flaws are always Infernal powers.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, chapter 9

entries.title: Demonic Powers (Coagulation, Obsession, Envisioning, Possession)
entries.summary: The powers common to demons: Coagulation to form a body, Obsession to impose a sinful Personality Trait on a mortal (with a worked example), Envisioning for dreams and waking visions, and Possession, which uses a separate Possession Might Pool.
quotes: Manifesting a physical form takes a round for every point of Infernal Might possessed by the demon
the victim's player must make a simple roll and add the Obsession Trait; this must be lower than a simple roll + any other suitable Personality Trait to successfully resist the impulses
the demon may expend any number of points from its Might Pool to create a Possession Might Pool

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.75

entries.title: Demonic Weaknesses
entries.summary: Every demon is vulnerable to expressions of God's power and has one extra weakness chosen from a list (abhorrent material, compulsiveness, ordering, protected group, running water, vulnerability). Learning a particular demon's weakness takes a roll.
quotes: must make an Intelligence + Infernal Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 9 + (Might /5)
Subtract 3 from the Ease Factor if the demon is a member of a family

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.41

entries.title: What are Demons?
entries.summary: Defines what counts as a demon (any creature with an Infernal Might) and the celestial, terrestrial and Infernal-angel origins, which have no functional differences in play.
quotes: There are no functional differences between any of these groups.

entries.title: Demonic Might Tables (Order and Rank)
entries.summary: Tables giving the Infernal Might range and relative frequency of ranks for each of the nine demonic orders, plus the extra Infernal Might and equivalent Reputation each rank grants.
quotes: | Master | +5 | 3 |
| Prince | +20 | 9 |

entries.title: Common Demonic Traits
entries.summary: Traits all demons share: Infernal Might, a defining sin as a Personality Trait, and an inability to display virtuous Personality Traits of their own free will.
quotes: A demon automatically fails personality rolls (ArM5, page 18) if succeeding would make it act in a virtuous manner.

entries.title: Demonic Might: Order and Rank
entries.summary: Explains that a demon's Infernal Might comes from its order plus a bonus for its rank, and that the two sources are indistinguishable in play.

entries.title: Demonic Reputations
entries.summary: Demons may have Infernal Reputations known to other demons and infernalists; the highest of these and the rank's equivalent Reputation gives the demon's Hierarchy score used when it is summoned.
quotes: The Hierarchy score of a demon is the highest of any Infernal Reputations it has

entries.title: Demonic Characteristics
entries.summary: How to assign Characteristics to a demon: physical Characteristics are bought with points based on Infernal Might, mental ones with a small allotment, with a minimum physical score and no maximum. Includes example Infernal Reputations.
quotes: Demon Physical Characteristics points: Infernal Might
Demon Mental Characteristics points: 0 – 7 (possibly more for powerful demons)

entries.title: Example Infernal Reputations
entries.summary: Table of example Infernal Reputation titles for each band of Reputation score, useful when giving a demon a Reputation.

entries.title: Infernal Ghosts
entries.summary: How to build an Infernal ghost as a demon: its role determines its order, and it lacks the Coagulation Power and physical statistics.
quotes: Infernal ghosts should be designed like any other demon, except that they have no Power of Coagulation

entries.title: False Gods (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for False Gods: Might limit, usual ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Shroud the Stench of the Pit, The Wealth of Nations and His Master's Voice.
quotes: Personality Traits: Proud +6
for every point of Infernal Might possessed by the demon

entries.title: Spirits of Deceit (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Spirits of Deceit: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Change Form, Trust of the Innocent, Forked Tongue of the Serpent and The Serpent's Oracle.
quotes: The Size of the altered form is limited to whatever is natural for the species
An Intelligence roll against an Ease Factor of 6 is allowed to resist the effect.

entries.title: Vessels of Iniquity (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Vessels of Iniquity: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Form of Wickedness (a special Coagulation), Form of Man and Contagious Obsession.
quotes: A Stamina stress roll against an Ease Factor of 6 is needed every hour
For every victim who comes under the sway of the Obsession, the demon loses a point from its Might Pool

entries.title: Avengers of Evil (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Avengers of Evil: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Punish the Sinner Power, whose wound depends on the victim's unatoned sin.
quotes: he suffers a Heavy wound if this Power penetrates his Magic Resistance
a number of points of damage equal to a simple die plus the sum total of all his sinful Personality Traits

entries.title: Deluders (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Deluders: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Delusion and Duplicate the Magi's Technique-based spell effects.
quotes: A minor illusion which affects an Individual amount of material (such as the demon itself) costs one point
It cannot create any effect with a level greater than its Infernal Might, or duplicate Ritual effects.

entries.title: Aerial Powers (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Aerial Powers: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Elemental Control and Recalcitrance, which inflates the demon's effective Might against control attempts.
quotes: at a cost of 1 Might Point per magnitude of effect
treats the demon's Might as if it were one-and-a-half times its actual Might

entries.title: Furies (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Furies: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Waxing Tide of Humors, Beserker Rage and Endurance of the Enraged.
quotes: must make a stress roll against an Ease Factor of 9
The Furies do not suffer from wound penalties, except on Defense totals.

entries.title: Accusers (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Accusers: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and the Powers Betrayal of the Heart and Whispers Behind the Back.
quotes: This Power lasts for a month.

entries.title: Tempters & Evil Spirits (Demonic Order)
entries.summary: Order template for Tempters and Evil Spirits, the largest order: Might limit, ranks, Personality Traits and Flaws, with no Powers specific to the order.
quotes: Personality Traits: Selfish +5

entries.title: Tainted Virtues and Flaws (limits)
entries.summary: Explains the Tainted category of Virtues and Flaws and the limit on how many a starting character may have.
quotes: no more than five points of Tainted Flaws and five points of Tainted Virtues

entries.title: Demonic Blood
entries.summary: Extended rules for a character with a demon parent: Infernal Might, up to 30 levels of Infernal Powers paid with Might Points, an attendant ruach, accelerated aging, and restrictions on other Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: she is an Infernal being and possesses an Infernal Might (Corpus) score of 5
The Might cost for each Power is equal to its magnitude divided by two (but always at least one point).
increases two years for every year that passes

entries.title: Tainted Characters
entries.summary: Introduces tainted people, children whose creation demons meddle with so that they become tools in the demons' schemes.

entries.title: Key Flaws for the Tainted
entries.summary: Tainted player characters must take Tragic Life or Plagued by Supernatural Entity and at least one Tainted Virtue or Flaw.
quotes: All tainted characters should have at least one Tainted Virtue or Flaw.

entries.title: Characters with Demonic Blood (guidance)
entries.summary: Guidance on demon-blooded characters: sterile, no need to eat but still hungry, short tragic lives, usable as storyguide characters, and unable to have The Gift.
quotes: A demon-blooded character cannot have The Gift because he is a member of the Infernal realm

entries.title: Virtues and Flaws for Corrupted Beasts
entries.summary: The restricted list of Virtues and Flaws a corrupted beast may take.
quotes: Virtues: Greater Immunity, Greater Infernal Power, Ferocity, Lesser Immunity, Lesser Infernal Power

entries.title: Corrupted Beast (Flaw)
entries.summary: The compulsory Flaw that gives an animal an Infernal Might, a sinful Personality Trait, a repellent appearance and the Tainted with Evil Flaw, while leaving it unbothered by The Gift.
quotes: The creature has been corrupted by Infernal power, and has acquired an Infernal Might of 5.
Corrupted Beasts do not react negatively to The Gift.

entries.title: Greater Infernal Power (Corrupted Beasts)
entries.requires: Virtue: Greater Infernal Power (Corrupted Beasts only)
entries.summary: How to design a corrupted beast's Greater Infernal Power as a spell-like effect, with its Might cost, initiative bonus and level cap.
quotes: The level of effect cannot exceed the Corrupted Beast's (Infernal Might + 10).
A Greater Power typically costs its magnitude in Might points to activate, and has an Init bonus equal to Qik + magnitude.

versions.title: Greater Infernal Power (corrupted beasts)
versions.summary: Rules for giving a corrupted beast a Power that must penetrate, designed with the Maleficia rules, including level cap, Might cost and Initiative.
quotes: with a level of effect that cannot exceed the corrupted beast's (Infernal Might + 10)
has an Initiative bonus equal to Quickness + magnitude

entries.title: Lesser Infernal Power (Corrupted Beasts)
entries.requires: Virtue: Lesser Infernal Power (Corrupted Beasts only)
entries.summary: How to design a corrupted beast's Lesser Infernal Power, which is cheap to use and cannot need a Penetration total (otherwise it counts as a Greater Power).
quotes: The level of effect cannot exceed the Corrupted Beast's Infernal Might.
A Minor power typically costs 0-2 Might points to activate, and has an Init bonus equal to magnitude.

versions.title: Lesser Infernal Power (corrupted beasts)
versions.summary: Rules for giving a corrupted beast a constant or cheap Power that needs no Penetration Total, including level cap, Might cost and Initiative.
quotes: The level of effect cannot exceed the corrupted beast's Infernal Might.
adds 2 to the Infernal Might of the corrupted beast

entries.title: Ferocity (animal Confidence)
entries.summary: Gives an animal a Confidence score that it may only use in situations that trigger its corrupt nature.
quotes: in such circumstances the creature has 3 Confidence Points

entries.title: Infernal Blessing
entries.summary: Explains how a Minor or Major Infernal Blessing grants a pool of unholy effect levels designed like maleficia, with a cap per effect, plus a list of example blessings, Warping Points and a Reputation gain.
quotes: If this is a Major Virtue, you receive 120 levels of effects, and the maximum level of an effect is level 60.
Taking this Virtue also gives the character 3 Warping Points

entries.title: Infernal Traditions: learning Infernal Abilities and Favored Abilities
entries.requires: Touched by evil (Warping Point from an Infernal source, a deal with a demon, or any Infernal Virtue or Flaw)
entries.summary: Defines Infernal traditions for game purposes, who can learn Infernal Supernatural Abilities and how the study activity works, and the four Favored Abilities each tradition specializes in (one tradition per lifetime).
quotes: you must subtract the character's scores in other Supernatural Abilities from the total experience gained in a season of study, and you must reach a score of 1 in that season to learn the Ability.
Infernal traditions usually have four Supernatural Abilities in which they specialize

entries.title: Unknowing Evil (playing an unwitting Luciferan)
entries.summary: Optional rule letting the storyguide disguise a Luciferan character's Powers under Divine-sounding names so the player can portray an infernalist who believes he is holy.
quotes: labeling Debauchery, Diablerie, and Malediction as Purity, Adjuration, and Cursing

entries.title: The Damhadh-Duidsan (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Damhadh-Duidsan (House Ex Miscellanea lineage)
entries.summary: Hermetic lineage descended from a Gaelic hedge wizard that uses rune-based curses; gives the Favored Abilities and a template for designing a member, with Giant Blood common.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Consumption, Incantation, Malediction, Shapechanging
use the Ex Miscellanea character template, taking Puissant Corpus, Necessary Condition (runes), and either Shapechanging, Giant Blood, or Incantation for your free Virtues and Flaws

entries.title: The Ordo Vagorum (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Ordo Vagorum (Goliards; Clerk or Educated, sinful Compulsion)
entries.summary: Wandering student-clergy infernalists (Goliards) loosely tied to House Mercere; lists Favored Abilities and the requirements for joining, such as Clerk or Educated plus a sinful Compulsion and an Infernal background Virtue or Flaw.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Consumption, Corruption, Debauchery, Psychomachia
they should take either Clerk or Educated, and have some sort of sinful Compulsion

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, p.93 Goliards

entries.title: The Witches of Thessaly (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Witches of Thessaly (Ex Miscellanea or other witches; Chthonic Magic)
entries.summary: Chthonic witches of Thessaly and their Hermetic sisters; lists Favored Abilities, notes that kin in the tradition learn Supernatural Abilities without penalty, and gives free Virtue and Flaw suggestions for Ex Miscellanea Thessalians.
quotes: Favored Abilties: Chthonic Magic, Commanding, Hex, Summoning
for as members of the same Infernal tradition they can learn their Supernatural Abilities without penalty

entries.title: Infernal Tradition: Stringla
entries.summary: Rules for the Byzantine stringla witch tradition: favored Abilities, common Virtues and Flaws, the Infernal Blessing rite and three extra powers granted by a maleficium cast by the coven leader.
quotes: Ceremony, Debauchery, Effusion, Phantasm
This maleficium is level 25 (base 4, +1 Touch, +4 Forsaken), granting the stringla a supernatural ability.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, pages 85-86, 129 (Strigae)

entries.title: Infernal Tradition: The Paulicians
entries.summary: Describes the Paulician heretical sect secretly serving the Infernal and lists its favored Abilities.
quotes: Ceremony, Debauchery, Diablerie, Malediction

entries.title: Infernal Hierarchy and Reputation
entries.summary: Introduces Infernal Reputations, the starting Infernal Reputation of level 1 and the Hierarchy Score used in Infernal Power formulas.
quotes: This is simply the same as the score of the highest Reputation possessed by the character.
may begin with an appropriate Infernal Reputation of level 1

entries.title: Building a Corrupted Dragon
entries.summary: Explains how to create game statistics for a corrupted dragon, either from Infernal and beast Virtues and Flaws or by adding Infernal Virtues and Flaws to a Magic dragon, which then uses Infernal Might.
quotes: In most cases, a corrupted beast is a tainted version of a mundane beast, and game statistics are created by adding Infernal Virtues and Flaws to the mundane beast's existing statistics.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.77-79
Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp.38-43

entries.title: Supernatural Abilities (type)
entries.requires: Virtue granting the Ability, or The Gift
entries.summary: Rules for obtaining Supernatural Abilities at creation, their realm of origin and the Warping immunity that goes with it, and how The Gift lets Gifted characters learn them in play.
quotes: Characters may only gain Supernatural Abilities during character creation if they have the Virtue granting the Ability.
If you have no reason to choose otherwise, your Ability is granted by the Magic realm

entries.title: Ex Miscellanea Traditions
entries.summary: Introduces three simple Ex Miscellanea magical traditions that can be chosen for a maga, noting others are in Houses of Hermes: Societates.
quotes: House Ex Miscellanea is not at all unified, consisting of many different magical traditions.

entries.title: Beast Masters
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: A tradition of summoning and controlling wild creatures; members get Animal Ken and a Minor Magical Focus with a group of animals, the Incompatible Arts Flaw, and a Virtue and Flaw balance of their own.
quotes: They must take at least one more Flaw to balance their Virtues, and then have only 8 points of Flaws available to them to buy another 8 points of Virtues.

entries.title: Summon Animals
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to summon mundane animals by an audible call; the Ability score sets the number and size of animals arriving, and a Communication + Summon Animals roll sets arrival time.
quotes: He must then make a Communication + Summon Animals roll against an Ease Factor of 9.

entries.title: The Nemthengacha
entries.summary: Background of the Nemthengacha, an Ex Miscellanea tradition of Celtic and Scandinavian sorcerers who create animosity and dissent in listeners.
quotes: The Nemthengacha (singular: Nemthenga) are a sect of Ex Miscellanea magi who have the ability to create animosity and dissent in their listeners.

entries.title: Nemthengacha Powers
entries.summary: A Nemthenga receives Embitterment as a free Major Non-Hermetic Virtue, Deficient Technique Rego as a compulsory Major Flaw, and Subtle Magic as a free Minor Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: Each has the Major Hermetic Flaw: Deficient Technique Rego.

entries.title: Tempestaria (Weather Witch)
entries.summary: A Saxon weather-witch tradition using simple sympathetic tools, with Whistle Up The Wind as its Major Non-Hermetic Virtue, Affinity with Auram, and a Necessary Condition Flaw.
quotes: Major Hermetic Flaw: Necessary Condition (tools for their magic to work)

entries.title: Whistle Up The Wind
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to create a wind of a chosen strength by whistling, with an Ease Factor table by strength, changeable with Communication + Music rolls, diminishing each sunset.
quotes: makes a Stamina + Whistle Up The Wind roll, against the Ease Factor listed in the table below

entries.title: Folk Dancer (Communal Dance Magic)
entries.summary: A vestigial communal magical tradition in which a troupe of folk dancers performs a long dance, each passing a Dexterity + Carouse roll, to create a minor magical effect; troupes know only a few fixed dances negotiated at character creation.
quotes: A troupe of a dozen or more folk dancers, who all make Dexterity + Carouse rolls of 9+ can perform a dance

entries.title: House Ex Miscellanea: Compulsory Tradition Virtues and Flaws
entries.summary: Every magus Ex Miscellanea gets a compulsory Major non-Hermetic Virtue, Major Hermetic Flaw and Minor Hermetic Virtue for his tradition, in addition to the normal allocation; this section explains what each represents and which Virtues and Flaws are typical.
quotes: All members of this House have their particular tradition represented by a Major non-Hermetic Virtue, a Major Hermetic Flaw, and a Minor Hermetic Virtue (ArM5, page 30).
Note that Hermetic Virtues and Flaws, including the ones gained by being a member of House Ex Miscellanea, affect only the exercise of Hermetic magic, not non-Hermetic powers.

entries.title: Magi Ex Miscellanea Without a Major Supernatural Ability
entries.summary: Allows the compulsory Major non-Hermetic Virtue of a magus Ex Miscellanea to be something other than a Supernatural Ability, and sets limits on designing such Virtues.
quotes: New Supernatural Virtues that are not controlled by an Ability score should be designed following the rules for effects instilled into items, complete with uses per day, and should not exceed seventh magnitude.

entries.title: Magi Orbi
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea (exile from another House)
entries.summary: How to create a magus orbus, an exile from another House who joined House Ex Miscellanea, built with the former House's rules but without its privileges and Mystery Cults, and with an Orbus Reputation.
quotes: A magus orbus has a Hermetic Reputation as an Orbus at a score of 2, and probably avoids his former colleagues.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp.52, 73
Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal pp.62-64

entries.title: Supernatural Abilities (Designing Tradition Virtues)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea or storyguide design
entries.summary: Introduces the system for designing a new Major Supernatural Virtue to be the mainstay of a tradition's magic, usable for player magi Ex Miscellanea and for non-player characters.
quotes: This section provides guidance on how a troupe can design a new Major Supernatural Virtue to be the mainstay of the magic of a tradition in House

entries.title: Designing a Supernatural Ability
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea or storyguide design
entries.summary: How to design a Major Supernatural Ability: describe its effect by Range, Duration, Target and base guideline, fix three parameters and let one vary with the Ability score or the Ease Factor achieved, and specify its non-Hermetic invocation.
quotes: All Supernatural Abilities designed by these rules are Major Supernatural Virtues.
All Supernatural Abilities fix three of these parameters as unchangeable, and allow one to vary according to either the score in the Ability or the Ease Factor achieved by the Casting Total.

entries.title: Control Fertility (Supernatural Ability)
entries.summary: An example Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws fertility in plants, animals and people; the Ability score sets the possible effects and a Presence roll sets how long they last.
quotes: She must then make a Presence + Fertility roll against an Ease Factor of 9 to affect the target with the chosen power for a month

entries.title: Magi Ex Miscellanea (Favored Ability)
entries.summary: Says that a House-Virtue Supernatural Ability counts as the magus's Favored Ability, so no Source Quality penalty from his Art scores applies when learning it after Hermetic training.
quotes: If a Supernatural Ability is acquired as part of the apprenticeship of a magus Ex Miscellanea (that is, as his House Virtue), then this Ability should be considered to be his Favored Ability

entries.title: Difficult Arts
entries.summary: Difficult Arts are bought and advanced like Abilities rather than Arts, but otherwise act as Arts for vis study, Magical Foci and Virtues that affect Arts.
quotes: it costs 5 experience points for a score of 1, 15 experience points for a score of 2, etc

entries.title: Accelerated Abilities
entries.summary: The counterpart to Difficult Arts: Abilities that advance like Arts at one experience point for a score of 1, are not capped at creation, and are otherwise treated as Abilities.
quotes: costing one experience point for a score of 1

versions.title: Accelerated Abilities
versions.summary: Introduces Accelerated Abilities, Supernatural Abilities that advance on the Art experience scale and are compared with high Ease Factors such as Mights or spell levels, and lists the few ways they differ from standard Abilities.
quotes: The only other difference between a Supernatural Accelerated Ability and a Supernatural Ability is that the equivalent spell level for an Accelerated Ability is equal to the Casting Total, not (Ability x 5).

entries.title: Favored Abilities
entries.requires: Gifted member of a tradition with favored Supernatural Abilities
entries.summary: Gifted characters of some traditions need not subtract their favored Supernatural Ability scores from the source quality when learning other favored Abilities, but do subtract all of them when learning non-favored ones.

versions.title: Favored Abilities
versions.summary: Defines Favored Abilities, a group of Supernatural Abilities that do not penalize each other's Source Quality for learning, and states which Abilities are favored for magi Ex Miscellanea.
quotes: Magi Ex Miscellanea treat the Hermetic Arts and the Supernatural Ability of their tradition as Favored Abilities.

entries.title: Creating Hedge Characters
entries.summary: Introduces the general framework for generating hedge wizard characters that each tradition chapter builds on.

entries.title: Hedge wizard as a Gifted Companion
entries.summary: A Gifted companion gets The Gift for free, up to a set number of Virtue points balanced by Flaws, and usually gains access to the tradition's whole suite of powers through a free Social Status after Opening The Gift.
quotes: Such a character may have up to 10 points worth of Virtues and balancing Flaws

entries.title: Hedge wizard as an unGifted Companion
entries.summary: An unGifted hedge wizard buys each power through individual Virtues and has no Gift to Open, so is typically weaker than a Gifted one.
quotes: An un-Gifted companion character may have up to 10 points worth of Virtues and balancing Flaws.

entries.title: Concerns in building hedge characters
entries.summary: Reminds troupes to follow the normal Virtue and Flaw mix for each character type, that only Gifted companions may take Hermetic Virtues and Flaws, and how hedge characters compare in power to magi when allocating them to players.
quotes: only Gifted companion characters may be assigned Hermetic Virtues and Flaws

entries.title: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws for hedge wizards
entries.summary: A Gifted hedge wizard may take Hermetic Virtues and Flaws that make sense for his tradition; unGifted members may get Supernatural versions, and may only take a Supernatural Flaw that limits a Virtue he has.
quotes: An unGifted character may only take a Supernatural Flaw of this sort if he has a Virtue that will be limited by it.

entries.title: Free Social Status: (Hedge Wizard)
entries.summary: Each tradition has its own free Social Status Virtue: for Gifted members it reflects the Opening of The Gift and access to favored Abilities or Arts, while unGifted members need the individual Virtues but still gain the social standing.

entries.title: Arcane Abilities of hedge wizards
entries.summary: The hedge wizard Social Status gives access to the Arcane Abilities Finesse, Magic Lore and Penetration, and often a tradition-specific analogue of Magic Theory.
quotes: at least the Arcane Abilities Finesse, Magic Lore, and Penetration

entries.title: (Hedge Magic) Theory
entries.requires: Hedge tradition with a theoretical basis
entries.summary: An Arcane Ability covering the technical practice of a hedge tradition's magic; traditions without practitioners holding it are poor at innovation, new effects and teaching.

entries.title: (Organization) Lore for hedge traditions
entries.summary: A General Ability for the legends, history, structure and goals of each hedge tradition; membership is not required, and some traditions use it in initiations.

entries.title: Inherited and Learned Powers
entries.summary: Hedge powers are either inherited as Supernatural Virtues that the tradition then trains, or learned through teaching, initiations or Opening the Gift; players should decide how a character acquired his powers.

entries.title: Hedge powers during character generation
entries.summary: A Gifted companion with an Opened Gift may spend starting experience on tradition Arts and Abilities, while an unGifted one may only do so for those powers for which he has the corresponding Virtues.

entries.title: Folk Witch Opening the Gift
entries.summary: Opening a folk witch's Gift follows the general rules with a folk-witch Opening Total and grants seven favored Supernatural Abilities, which troupes can swap for others.
quotes: FOLK WITCH OPENING TOTAL: Int + Folk Witch Magic Theory + Sabbat Bonus

entries.title: Organization Lore: Folk Witches
entries.summary: The Ability covers folk witch effects, coven locations and reputations; its specialty is a home coven, with extra botch dice for covens farther away.
quotes: roll an additional botch die for every week's travel this coven is from the character's "home" coven

entries.title: Gifted Companions
entries.summary: Step-by-step method for creating a Gifted hedge wizard who keeps a native tradition instead of Hermetic magic: take The Gift and Hermetic Magus status, build as a Companion with Arcane Abilities, and gain a Hedge Wizard Reputation.
quotes: Take The Gift and Hermetic Magus Social Status Virtues.
Gain the Reputation Hedge Wizard 2 (Hermetic)

entries.title: Damhadh-Duidsan (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Ogam rune tradition that curses enemies and steals their life, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Shapechanging, Giant Blood, or Incantation

entries.title: Hermetic Haruspexes (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Hermetic Haruspexes tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the Roman tradition of divination by inspecting the entrails of sacrificed animals, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and its susceptibility to Twilight.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Divination and Augury

entries.title: Karaites (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Karaite Jewish tradition of holy magic, which may join the Order only if it practises holy magic, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Holy Magic

entries.title: Malocchi (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Italian tradition of Entrancement through the gaze, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and a required extra Virtue.
quotes: As well as his free Virtues and Flaws, a maloccho must also take Piercing Gaze as a compulsory Virtue.

entries.title: Scinnfolk (Gifted Companions Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the cunning-folk tradition of Gifted Companions who keep natural and faerie charms instead of Hermetic magic, with its Virtue and common Virtue and Flaw choices.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Fertility (free with The Gift)

entries.title: Witches of Thessaly (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Witches of Thessaly tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the Thessalian tradition of sorcery, necromancy and curses, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and a note on its suspicion of diabolism.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Summoning

entries.title: Warding (Columbae)
entries.summary: The Columbae's Accelerated Ability for drawing chalk circles that ward away a subset of one Form. The Warding Total acts as a Casting Total for natural targets and as Penetration against beings with Might, but is useless against Magic Resistance without Might.
quotes: Warding Total: stress die + Stamina + Warding + aura
a ward against objects made of wood requires a Warding Total of at least 30

related.text: ArM5 p.114 Ring Duration / Circle Target

entries.title: Mythic Herbalism
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability for brewing healing poultices, poisons and potions of physical bonuses: preparation time scales with the Ease Factor, extra doses raise the Ease Factor, and an Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism roll decides success. Describes expiry, duration and stacking limits.
quotes: a number of days equal to one-third the Ease Factor of the intended effect
the Ease Factor is increased by one for each additional dose
roll the character's Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism against the target Ease Factor

entries.title: Learned Magician Character Generation
entries.summary: How Gifted and unGifted learned magicians are built: starting age, the Opening of the Gift, yearly experience points and charms, and the lack of a formal apprenticeship.
quotes: Each year that the learned magician trains under a master he gains 30 experience points.
The player may also spend experience points on charms, at a rate of 5 levels of charms per experience point.

entries.title: Typical Learned Magician Abilities
entries.summary: Abilities typical of learned magicians, minimum Latin and Artes Liberales scores needed for charms and amulets, and Virtues and Flaws that suit the tradition.
quotes: All magicians must possess minimum scores of 1 in Latin to learn charms and 1 in Artes Liberales to create amulets and chartae or cast charms from text.

entries.title: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws for Learned Magicians
entries.summary: Lists the Hermetic Virtues and Flaws available to learned magicians, noting that some suit only those with The Gift.

entries.title: UnGifted Mathematicus Initiations
entries.summary: Explains that an unGifted mathematicus takes both the Flaw and Virtue for each Initiation, that the examples given are only examples, and that Ordeal Flaws relate to the ability to practice magic.
quotes: A player who wishes to play a companion mathematicus must take both the Flaw and Virtue for each Initiation listed.

entries.title: Initiation into the Tueor Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Tueor Technique: a season of service with a Philosophiae test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +20 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Fortunam Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Fortunam Form: a season of service with a Theology test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Magicam Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Magicam Form: a season of service with a Magic Lore test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Salutem Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Salutem Form: a season of service with a Medicine test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Hermetic Learned Magicians
entries.requires: Tradition: Learned Magicians (member of the Order)
entries.summary: How to build a nominally Hermetic learned magician: the required Flaw and Virtue and where the Arcane Lore experience goes.
quotes: A nominally Hermetic learned magician character should take the Flaw Hedge Wizard and the Virtue Arcane Lore.

entries.title: Mythic Alchemists Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the mythic alchemist alternate tradition and its required Virtues, Flaws, Arts and Abilities.
quotes: Required Virtues and Flaws: Mythic Alchemy, Laboratory Magician, and No Text Casting

entries.title: Mythic Alchemist Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for mythic alchemists, who follow the learned magician guidelines with idiosyncratic training and typical Abilities.

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the cunning-folk alternate tradition and its required Virtues, Arts and Abilities.
quotes: Required Virtues: Mythic Herbalism and Entreat the Faerie Powers

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for cunning-folk: apprenticeship length, yearly experience and spell levels, and typical Abilities, Social Status, Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: For each year of training, the player may spend 16 experience points in Abilities or Arts and 8 levels of spells.

entries.title: Induction of Hedge Wizards into the Order
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix (inducting maga)
entries.summary: Procedure for bringing a Gifted hedge wizard into the Order: a short apprenticeship in Hermetic basics, an attempt to open the Arts that may destroy non-Hermetic powers, a season teaching the Parma Magica, then the Oath. Explains the Flaws and Gifted Companion status that can result.
quotes: typically lasting less than five years
The Pralician maga need not have all Arts above 5 for this process

entries.title: Sihr (Summoning and Bargaining with Jinn)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability for summoning a jinni and bargaining it into service. Covers discerning a jinni's Might, the vis cost and Summoning Total, extra summoning time, the Bargain Total against an Ease Factor, botches, and how many jinn may be kept in service.
quotes: Summoning Total: Presence + Sihr + Aura + stress die
Bargain Total: Communication + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die
Ease Factor: 18 + Bargain Modifiers

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

entries.title: Hyperborean New Virtues (Hymnist and Descent)
entries.summary: The character-creation Virtues that grant access to the hymns: Hyperborean Hymnist (a starting hymn with its powers already infused), and Minor and Major Hyperborean Descent (longevity, spirit affinity, a Mythic Blood variant with a bird or flight feat).
quotes: Your character starts with one recited hymn, which confers the Supernatural Ability of [Hymn] 1, and 15 levels of Powers (which have already been infused at the start of play).

entries.title: Supernatural Ability: Hyperborean Hymn
entries.summary: Each hymn is a separate Supernatural Ability: every level gives levels of powers, adds to Soak against the hymn's principles, and can be added to a Lab Total when the hymn is involved in the effect or item.
quotes: For each level of a Hymn Ability, your character gains 15 levels of powers (see below for details).
Hymns may be also used in the laboratory, by adding the Ability to your character's Lab Total if the hymn involves either the effect or item being enchanted.

entries.title: Dead Language: Hyperborean
entries.summary: The Hyperborean language, understood by spirits and related to Ancient Greek; it aids hymn recitation but is not required, and its alphabet needs a separate level of Artes Liberales.
quotes: everyday usage, poetry, religious usage, talking to spirits.

entries.title: Puissant hymns and hymn Affinities
entries.summary: Affinity with Ability and Puissant Ability can be taken for a hymn; Puissant raises recitation and Soak totals but does not increase the points for Powers.
quotes: Puissant Hymn effectively increases your hymn recitation totals for that hymn, and other totals that may use your character's Hymn Ability score (such as Soak).

entries.title: Converts to the Order (hedge wizards joining Hermes)
entries.requires: Hedge wizard character who swears the Oath of Hermes (House Ex Miscellanea)
entries.summary: How to build a Gifted hedge wizard who has converted to the Order: use the tradition's creation rules up to the Oath, then continue as a Hermetic magus, with limits on learning the Hermetic Arts and social consequences of the conversion.
quotes: Once the character has sworn the Oath of Hermes he gains the free Social Status Virtue Hermetic Magus

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Societates, House Ex Miscellanea

entries.title: Elementalist Characters (Arts, vis use and study)
entries.summary: Elementalist magic uses four Techniques and four Forms that work only in combination and come in Medicinal, Philosophical and Theurgical types; it also covers how elementalists add vis to totals and study their Arts from vis or books.
quotes: receiving a +2 bonus for each pawn of vis that corresponds to the Elementalist Form used in the formula
spend a number of pawns of vis associated with that Form equal to (their score in the Technique / 2), rounded up

related.text: Hedge Magic: Acquiring Hedge Wizard Powers

entries.title: Elemental Affinities & Character Creation
entries.requires: Tradition: Elementalists (Elemental Magic, Medicine, Philosophiae or Theurgy)
entries.summary: Optional character creation method that approximates these Virtues' free experience by treating them as an Affinity with the related Forms.
quotes: an optional method is to treat the Virtue as an Affinity with the related Forms

entries.title: Elementalist Societies (and Opening the Gift)
entries.summary: Societies teach particular Techniques and Forms; a Gifted member opens a Gifted student's Gift using a specific Opening Total, and the society's Arts indicate what unGifted initiates can be taught.
quotes: OPENING TOTAL: Intelligence + highest Technique + lowest Form + aura

entries.title: Apostles of Apollonius
entries.summary: An elementalist society that favors (Theurgical) Summoning, (Theurgical) Controlling and all four Elementalist Forms, with history and notes on its distribution in 1220.

entries.title: Ikhwan as-Safa' (Brethren of Purity)
entries.summary: An elementalist society whose Arts are Philosophical Summoning, Philosophical Refining and all four Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Teaching of the Brethren of Purity (grades)
entries.summary: The Brethren advance through four grades with minimum Ability scores; Gifted members learn the society's Arts directly while unGifted members must be initiated.

entries.title: Ikhwan as-Safa' Characters
entries.summary: Character generation notes for Brethren: yearly experience points for Arcane and Academic Abilities, typical Abilities, Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: they receive 30 experience points to spend on Arcane and Academic Abilities

related.text: Learned Magicians: Mythic Alchemy, Mythic Herbalism

entries.title: Tulab Ibn Sina
entries.summary: An elementalist society of Islamic physicians whose Arts are Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining and all four Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Teachings of Ibn Sina (access to Arts)
entries.summary: Who the Tulab accept as students; Gifted members learn Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining and the Forms, while unGifted members gain Arts only through Initiation.
quotes: Gifted members of this tradition learn Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining, and all the Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Tulab Ibn Sina Characters
entries.summary: Character generation notes for Tulab members: a short intense training period with set experience points, favored Abilities, typical Virtues and Flaws, and the Educated Virtue's allocation for Islamic lands.
quotes: In a five-year period, the student gains 150 experience points to spend on Academic and Arcane Abilities.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.101, 114

entries.title: Creating a Folk Witch Character
entries.summary: Folk witches may be Gifted or unGifted (companion or grog), need at least one Flaw limiting their magic and the free Folk Witch Status, spend a ten-year apprenticeship with a special experience allotment, and can do limited laboratory work during creation.
quotes: you may spend 200 experience points for the character on any Abilities
which gives her seven favored Supernatural Abilities
Each season spent on laboratory activities reduce the number of experience points received for that year by 10

entries.title: Folk Witch minimum Ability Scores
entries.summary: Minimum Ability scores expected of a Gifted folk witch after apprenticeship, and the language scores needed for a literate or writing witch.
quotes: she must have a score of at least 4 in a Language (which does not need to be Latin), and a score of at least 1 in Artes Liberales

entries.title: Folk Witch (Social Status)
entries.summary: The free Social Status that grants folk witch laboratory activities, casting methods and magical defenses, coven membership and sabbat attendance, and requires two seasons a year of self-support.
quotes: she must spend two seasons each year supporting herself

entries.title: Folk Witch Magic Theory
entries.summary: An Arcane Ability analogous to Magic Theory, covering the technical details of folk witch magic and used in kitchen laboratory activities; any character can be taught it.
quotes: Any character can be taught this Ability.

entries.title: Initiations for unGifted Folk Witches
entries.summary: unGifted witches are initiated by a Mystagogue who must know the power, with an Initiation Total using Presence and Theory; seven sample Scripts (Rhyme of the Beast, Venomous Darts, Sense of Place, Unbound by Land, Hands of Life, The Devil's Eye, Second Life) give the Supernatural Virtues and their ordeal Flaws.
quotes: FOLK WITCH INITIATION TOTAL: Mystagogue's Presence + Mystagogue's Folk Witch Magic Theory + Script Bonus + Sabbat Bonus
Script Bonus: +10 (+9 Major Ordeal, +1 Time)

entries.title: Gruagach Character Generation
entries.summary: How Gifted and unGifted gruagachan are built: when apprenticeship happens, how the Opening of the Gift grants the gruagach Arts, and how many experience points and spell levels each kind of apprenticeship provides.
quotes: 160 experience points for any Abilities, including Arcane ones or the gruagach Arts, and 80 levels of spells
For each year of training, the player may spend 16 experience points in Abilities or gruagach Arts and take 8 levels of spells.

entries.title: Typical Gruagach Abilities
entries.summary: Minimum Abilities and Arts a Gifted gruagach must have after apprenticeship, plus the Technique, Form, Pictish and Lore thresholds needed before taking the Fetch and External Soul Virtues and initiating unGifted students.
quotes: must have a score of 2 in Pictish and Gruagach Lore, as well as scores of 1 in all of the gruagach Arts

entries.title: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws for Gruagachan
entries.summary: Lists which Hermetic Virtues and Flaws gruagach characters may take, with notes on Quiet Magic and on Flaws forbidden to unGifted gruagachan.

entries.title: UnGifted Gruagach Initiations
entries.summary: Explains how unGifted gruagachan gain each Art through an independent Initiation Script in any order, with no self-Initiation, and the usual progression of Arts.
quotes: an unGifted gruagach may not self-Initiate any Arts

entries.title: Initiation into the Give Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Give Technique, a quest for justice followed by training, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +17 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Take Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Take Technique, a sacrifice at a place of worship followed by training, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +17 (+3 Special Place, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Initiate's Time)

entries.title: Initiation into the Blessing Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Blessing Form, requiring a permanent solution for a truly disadvantaged person, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Curse Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Curse Form, punishing a wicked individual with a poetically just penalty, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Shape Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Shape Form, defeating a shapechanger and being transformed into its shape for a lunar month, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Vision Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Vision Form, a fast and meditation at a Pictish holy site with Concentration rolls, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: The player must succeed in a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 9 on three consecutive attempts.

entries.title: Hermetic Gruagachan
entries.summary: How to build a gruagach who is nominally a member of the Order of Hermes: the required Flaw and Virtue, and the minimum Code of Hermes and Parma Magica scores.
quotes: A nominal Hermetic gruagach character should take the Flaw Hedge Wizard and the Virtue Arcane Lore.

entries.title: Trollsynir Tradition
entries.requires: Tradition: Trollsynir (Virtue: Giant Blood, Flaw: No Tattoo Magic)
entries.summary: Overview of the Norse trollsynir, an alternate tradition using the gruagach Arts, with their required Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: Required Virtues and Flaws: Giant Blood, No Tattoo Magic

entries.title: Trollsynir Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for trollsynir: no formal apprenticeship or training requirements, universally taught Abilities, and typical or inappropriate Virtues and Flaws.

entries.title: Kolduni Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the pagan wizards of the Novgorod Tribunal who use the gruagach Arts, with the required Flaw and favored Abilities.
quotes: Required Flaws: No Tattoo Magic

entries.title: Koldun Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for kolduni: use the gruagach generation rules, typical Abilities, available Social Statuses and appropriate Virtues and Flaws.

entries.title: Nightwalker Characters
entries.summary: Nightwalkers are built as conventional companions rather than Mythic Companions, and most have a mundane profession.
quotes: Nightwalkers are designed as conventional companions, not Mythic Companions like the most powerful members of the other traditions described in this book.

entries.title: Nightwalker New Virtues (regional traditions)
entries.summary: The Nightwalker Major Virtue must be localized by choosing a regional tradition (or a similar local group), and membership of a regional tradition is a Free Virtue.
quotes: Membership of each regional tradition is a Free Virtue.

entries.title: Nightwalker (Virtue powers and limitations)
entries.summary: The Nightwalker Virtue lets a character stray as a phantasticum, listing the powers it grants (Second Sight, tangible or intangible form, animal shapes, speaking to sleepers) and its duties and limitations such as a vulnerable body and shared injuries.
quotes: The character may make his spiritual form tangible or intangible using a Stamina + Concentration roll.

entries.title: Born With a Caul
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining the caul that most nightwalkers are born with, the possible Major Story Flaw for losing it, and the Virtues that having a caul can grant or often grants.
quotes: Knowledge of the nightwalkers is an (Organization) Lore

entries.title: Combat Statistics for Animal Phantastica
entries.summary: A system for building the animal-shaped phantasticum: combine the species statistics with the character's Characteristics, apply Size and body Virtues and Flaws, and use the animal's General Abilities.
quotes: if both the species and character have a negative score, use the lowest score. If both the species and the character have a positive score, use the highest.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic, Book of Mundane Beasts

entries.title: Benandanti Tradition
entries.summary: The north Italian good walkers: how recruits are summoned, the Ember Day Thursday battles against the malandanti, the Lady of the Game who appoints captains and revives eaten animals.
quotes: The benandanti fight in human form and are armed with bunches of fennel

entries.title: Hounds of God Tradition
entries.summary: The werewolf nightwalkers who raid Hell in wolf form three times a year; includes the two ways of becoming a Hound, notably the toasting ritual that passes the power on to another person.
quotes: the wolf does not drink to the toast, or give thanks for it

entries.title: Kresniki and Kudlaki Tradition
entries.summary: Slavic nightwalkers pairing a community protector, the kresnik, with a sorcerer rival, the kudlak, who steals fertility and may return as a vampire. Covers birth with a caul, the forced Versatile Phantasticum and the effects of a kudlak winning.
quotes: These characters are required to take the Versatile Phantasticum Virtue

entries.title: Mazzeru Tradition
entries.summary: Corsican nightwalkers who fight Infernal witches with asphodel and are also compelled to hunt in dreams, killing animals that foretell the death of villagers; accepting this costs no Flaw but resisting it gives a Story Flaw.
quotes: Mazzeri use stalks of asphodel as weapons.

entries.title: Taltos Tradition
entries.summary: Hungarian nightwalkers who fight in the sky as horses, bulls or flames. Covers the childhood coma and initiation, the battle schedule, recovery by eating, and the fact that most taltós lose their powers at some age.
quotes: Taltós fight in the forms of horses, bulls, or flames

entries.title: Statistics and Abilities for Flame Shape
entries.summary: Rules for a taltos in the form of a ball or wheel of flame, built from the characteristics of an elemental: fixed Characteristics, Abilities that can be used, fire Damage, fire vulnerability immunities and a Hungry Personality trait.
quotes: suffer +5 burn damage for each attack (Penetration 0)
and does +5 fire Damage

entries.title: Vitkar Magic Foci
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir; Virtue: Major or Minor Rune Focus
entries.summary: Explains how a vitkar magic focus works: the rune score is doubled for spells of the focus' purpose carved into its proper material. Lists the seven Sigrdrifumal types of rune magic with their materials and typical runes.
quotes: he may double his score in the rune used in the spell formula

entries.title: Craft: Runes
entries.summary: New Ability covering carving or inscribing runes into materials; it affects how long runes last and how well they can be hidden in a script.
quotes: This can be used to determine how long the runes last

entries.title: Rune Magic Ability
entries.summary: New Arcane Ability representing knowledge of vitkar magic and how to formulate rune scripts; interchangeable with the Ancient Magic Ability of the same name.
quotes: It deals with the technical details of each rune, how they may be used, and how to formulate a rune script.

entries.title: The Older Futhark (Rune Table)
entries.summary: Lists the 24 runes of the Elder Futhark by aett (Freya, Heimdall, Tyr), with each letter, name, meaning and the effects it governs.
quotes: The three aetts of the Elder Futhark are named after three gods

entries.title: The Anglo-Saxon Futhorc
entries.summary: Reference table of the extended Anglo-Saxon rune alphabet, giving each rune's name, pronunciation, meaning and the Elder Futhark rune it corresponds to, with five runes that have no Elder equivalent.
quotes: Scholars agree that it included the first 28 runes

entries.title: Studying the Ars Notoria
entries.summary: Learning the Ability from the text requires reading four languages and Artes Liberales, a Gifted reader and the normal rules for learning a Supernatural Ability; starting characters must take it as a Major Supernatural Virtue.
quotes: The reader needs a 4 in each Language to accurately read the book.
The Ars Notoria text is treated as a tractatus with a Quality of 20.

entries.title: New Methods and Powers
entries.summary: Guidance for storyguides on designing additional Methods and Powers for maleficia, including the minimum pairings and how to adapt an existing Method.
quotes: each new Method must be associated with at least two Powers, and each new Power must use at least one Method

entries.title: Chthonic Magic
entries.requires: Supernatural Ability: Chthonic Magic (lineage, tradition, societas, Hermetic Virtue or Mystery Cult)
entries.summary: Low magic associated with underworld gods and night spirits that is ambiguously Infernal: the magus is attuned to Magic and Infernal auras, can use Infernal vis safely and maleficia Ranges/Durations/Targets, and gains a doubled lowest Art after a sinful act.
quotes: Finally, a chthonic magus may always add his lowest Art score to his Lab Total or Casting Total twice
The chthonic magus becomes attuned to both Magical and Infernal auras, and so gains Warping Points from neither, and the benefits of both.

entries.title: Fector Characters
entries.requires: Social Status Virtue: Fector (Tradition: Hunters' Arts)
entries.summary: Character-creation rules for a non-Hermetic Fector: the Gift plus the free Fector Social Status Virtue, all three Practice Arts and three Foe Arts, free Second Sight, a five-year apprenticeship with a set pool of experience, and permitted starting Abilities.
quotes: A Fector has all three Practice Arts of Scry, Ban, and Slay, and can choose three Foe Arts.
During this time, the Fector receives 120 experience points that can be spent on the Hunters' Arts or on Abilities.

entries.title: Hermetic Fectores
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea (societas of Murat of Terezin)
entries.summary: Character-creation rules for a Hermetic Fector, a magus Ex Miscellanea who has one Practice Art as a free Major non-Hermetic Virtue with a Foe Art, a free Minor Magical Focus in harming a creature, and the Weak Spontaneous Magic Flaw.
quotes: Their free Minor Hermetic Virtue is a Minor Magical Focus in harming a particular supernatural creature
Their Major Hermetic Flaw is Weak Spontaneous Magic; the methodical preparation typical of a hunter comes at the expense of flexibility.

entries.title: Vampire Limitations (Traditional Wards)
entries.summary: Describes how folk rituals repel vampires because they feed the faerie vitality, and gives a list of limitations of which one to three are chosen for each vampire.
quotes: For each vampire, pick one to three of the following limitations; the vampire has to obey these rules:

related.text: Realms of Power: Faerie Traditional Ward

entries.title: Storm Wizards and Giants (Giant Blood and the mystery initiation)
entries.summary: Storm wizards get the Giant Blood Virtue free, earned by a mystery initiation at the end of apprenticeship in which the apprentice slays a giant and eats its heart. Powers are usable as soon as the Gift is opened, before the initiation.
quotes: If you are making a storm wizard character, this Virtue is free.
storm wizards undergo a mystery initiation in which they must slay a true giant and eat his heart

entries.title: Storm Wizard Magic
entries.summary: Overview of storm wizard magic: exclusively Gifted, Magic-realm powers built on three Supernatural Abilities, an Arcane Ability and a seasonal activity called ice harvesting.
quotes: Their magic consists of three favored Supernatural Abilities: Storm Calling, Storm Riding, and Storm Fighting.

entries.title: Storm Wizard Virtues and Abilities
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining that storm wizards gain their Supernatural Abilities at Score 0 when the Gift is opened, and giving the Storm Calling, Storm Riding and Storm Fighting Virtues, the free Storm Wizard status and the Organization Lore: Storm Wizard Arcane Ability.
quotes: Opening Total is generated as Intelligence + Organization Lore: Storm Wizards
